name: darkraise
description: Darkraise plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: dforge
plugins.description: Brainstorm, plan and execute with scored tasks, in-session execution, criteria-based review, UI/UX work proven in the running UI and external Antigravity and Codex reviewers; on Claude Code a cockpit pane shows the session, the run, context against its handoff budget, usage limits and the repo, with Discord notifications and an attribution guard.

plugins.name: dagents
plugins.description: Subagent-driven development: brainstorm, plan and execute scored tasks, each dispatched to an implementer agent on a model ladder and reviewed by a judge (inline execution on request), with external Antigravity and Codex executors, criteria-based review and UI/UX work proven in the running UI; on Claude Code a cockpit pane shows the session, the run, context against its handoff budget and usage limits. Continues the dforge 4.x workflow.

plugins.name: dflow
plugins.description: Plan, build, review and ship with a task gate that only a passing command can open: lean plans tracked on a board, one evidence-bound review per branch, UI proof, living docs checked mechanically, and a HUD.

plugins.name: darkraise-ui
plugins.description: Teaches coding agents to write idiomatic darkraise-ui code: the style, preset and theme-axis system, the CSS layer override contract, kit form and layout primitives over hand-rolled markup, and exact component props read live from the installed package's type definitions.

plugins.name: darkraise-win32ui
plugins.description: Teaches coding agents to write idiomatic Darkraise.Win32UI code: token-resolved visuals, the raise ladder and overlay-hover rule, the fluent View builder, convention-based MVVM and draml markup, plus the framework limits it must never promise past.
